output: Draft/final artifacts with author/source/status metadata.
decision_scope: Render the required representation.
boundary: Draft, finalized and delivered remain separate.
completion_check: Output matches source/version/required contract.
memory_policy: PATIENT_CASE_ONLY; approved general procedures read-only; no patient-derived cross-patient learning
activation: Only when the current assigned task/stage and actual tool contract require this work.

name: Operation gate and action journal
inputs: Principal, operation, payload, task/version and actual tool contract.
output: Permitted dispatch and observed receipt/unknown state.
decision_scope: Enforce the actual execution/retry envelope.
boundary: Valid model prose or JSON does not grant authority or exactly-once effects.
completion_check: Action identity and outcome evidence are recorded.
memory_policy: PATIENT_CASE_ONLY; approved general procedures read-only; no patient-derived cross-patient learning

name: Budget and work scheduler
inputs: Pending case-local work, dependencies and current resource limits.
output: Bounded execution/delegation plan.
decision_scope: Admit work and account for combined resource spend.
boundary: Cannot fan out every micro-role or reuse another patient’s reasoning.
completion_check: Queue, budget, cancellation and stop conditions are explicit.

activation: Only when the current assigned task/stage and actual tool contract require this work.

name: Case checkpoint and context reducer
inputs: Current case/request, protected obligations and coherent tool/dialogue history.
output: Case-scoped checkpoint/projection with retained source references.
decision_scope: Reduce context under the actual provider ownership contract.
boundary: Does not promote patient facts into reusable staff knowledge or prove lossless semantics.
completion_check: Active request, obligations, unknown effects and source versions survive or fail explicitly.

activation: Only when the current assigned task/stage and actual tool contract require this work.

name: Patient isolation barrier
inputs: Principal, organization, patient/case, source/query/cache namespaces.
output: Allowed case-local views or a denied/unresolved access.
decision_scope: Prevent patient-derived state crossing into another patient’s work.
boundary: Not satisfied by merely asking the model to ignore unrelated context.
completion_check: Cross-patient source injection is rejected before inference/tool use.
memory_policy: PATIENT_CASE_ONLY; approved general procedures read-only; no patient-derived cross-patient learning
activation: Only when the current assigned task/stage and actual tool contract require this work.

name: Bounded invariant critic
inputs: Permitted case facts, intended action/artifact and task-visible requirements.
output: Specific evidence-based defects or readiness limits.
decision_scope: Challenge unsupported claims and missing obligations.
boundary: Not hidden verifier, external reviewer or unlimited debate loop.
completion_check: Feedback cites the case-visible contradiction/requirement and stays within budget.
